newsitem.title: UK: Concert favoured to partner Portugal Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Concert favoured to partner Portugal Telecom.

text.p: Concert, the proposed joint venture between British Telecommunications and MCI, has emerged favourite to become partner of Portugal Telecom, the Financial Times said.
The paper said Portugal Telecom has held talks with Concert since last week to offer a stake of up to five percent.
Portugal Telecom, which is looking for a foreign partner, has also received bids from GlobalOne, the group led by Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and the AT&T-Unisource alliance.
Portugal Telecom, advised by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, will decide on its partner by April 15, the paper added.
